stretch.name: Stretch (%)
stretch.help: The amount of stretch to design for.

bulge.name: Bulge (%)
bulge.help: Controls the amount of extra room to create at the front of the trunks.

legReduction.name: Leg reduction (%)
legReduction.help: Reduces the leg opening to prevent gaping

backRise.name: Back rise (%)
backRise.help: Controls how much the waist is higher in the back than  the front.

elasticWidth.name: Elastic width (%)
elasticWidth.help: Width of the elastic at the waist

rise.name: Rise (%)
rise.help: Controls the height of the waist.
